about: App bundles for Pocket Box. `base` is what Pocket Box Lite carries (Pocket Core always runs too); `sudo pocket-install --bundle office,media` or `--apps notes,tasks` picks more, and so does pockethomelab.com/box/bundles, which reads this file. Every slug must be in apps.nix (the flake checks).

bundles.name: Essentials
bundles.description: The everyday basics for a household: notes, tasks, a shared calendar and contacts, files and photos, private search and a home page.

bundles.name: Office
bundles.description: Documents, email and paperwork: edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, scan and file papers, sign, invoice, run tables and forms, track time.

bundles.name: Developer
bundles.description: For people who build software and run servers: issues and roadmaps, code and pull-request review, error tracking, monitoring, databases, remote desktops and automations.

bundles.name: Media
bundles.description: Films, shows, music, photos, books, audiobooks, podcasts, radio and games for the whole household.

bundles.name: Home & family
bundles.description: Run the household: who picks up the children, the week's meals and shopping, chores, chat, shared costs, the house, the pets and gift lists.

bundles.name: Money
bundles.description: Personal finance in one place: spending and budgets, net worth, invoices, shared costs, cards and papers that run out, the car and rentals.

bundles.name: Health & outdoors
bundles.description: Your health data, training, food, habits, breathing and meditation, hikes and trips, and the weather for your places.
